name: Avoid Macros with High Fan-In (Easytrieve)
description:
Avoid Macros with High Fan-In (Fan-In > X). The Fan-In of an Artifact is the number of other Artifacts that are referencing it. When computing the Fan-In of an Artifact, multiple accesses to it from the same Artifact are counted as one access.
The threshold level is a parameter that can be changed at will.
For an Easytrieve Macro, these Artifacts are the Programs that include it with %NAME. A Macro shared on purpose, such as a record layout, can be included by many Programs: the default threshold is higher than for Procedures and Programs.
output:
Associated to each Easytrieve Macro with violations, the Quality Rule provides:
- The Fan-In
rationale:
An Artifact referenced by many other Artifacts is costly to change: a change can impact all of them, and all of them have to be tested again.
Changeability and testability decline with increasing Fan-In.
reference: Standard suggestions based on CAST Quality Model
remediation: Check that the Macro is shared on purpose. Otherwise split it into smaller Macros, so that each Program includes only what it uses.
